page.layout: One column of running text on a single printed page. Running head centred at the top, page number top right. Headings in italic and in large capitals, a rule divides the two sections. No marginal notes. Signature at the bottom left.

head.i: Quomodo in personam incertam transfer-tur rei proprietas?

main_text.p: Prætores & Consules cum missilia jactant in vul-gus; wenn sie geben[?] werffen unter das volck/ igno-rant quid eorum quisq; sit excepturus: & tamē quia volunt, quod quisq; acceperit ejus esse, statim eum Dominum efficiunt. §. hoc amplius. inst. eod.[?]

head.i: Cujus est res pro derelicto habita?

main_text.p: Si rem pro derelicto à domino habitam occupaverit quis, statim is dominus efficitur. Pro derelicto autem habetur quod Dominus ea mente abjecerit, ut id in numero rerum suarum esse nolit: ideoq; statim Dominus ejus esse desinit. §. qua ratione. insti-tut.eod.[?]
main_text.head: QUIS EST SECUNDUS Titulus? De rebus corporalibus & incorporalibus. Von leiblichen und unleiblichen gütern.
main_text.p: Quæ sui natura tangi possunt: veluti fundus, homo, vestis, aurum, argentum, & deniq; aliæ res innumerabiles §. corporales. inst. eod.[?]
Quæ tangi non possunt: qualia sunt ea, quæ in ju-re consistunt, sicut hæreditas, usufructus, usus & obligationes quoquo modo contractæ. §. incorpo-rales. inst. eod.[?]
Eodem numero sunt jura prædiorum urbanorū, & rusticorum, quæ etiam servitutes vocantur. §. fi-nal. inst. eod.[?]

page.notes: No marginal notes. The dashed rule between the two sections is ornament, not text. The reading of the abbreviation "eod." is doubtful in the scan (it may read "cod."), marked [?] throughout. The German in black letter, "wenn sie geben", is partly obscured by overlapping type, so "geben" is doubtful. The signature "G 2" may read differently, and the catchword is absent.
